name: Gordon症候群

summary.text: A rare genetic form of hypertension characterized by hyperkalemia, mild hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis, normal or elevated aldosterone, low renin, with normal renal glomerular filtration rate (GFR).
summary.evidence: A rare genetic form of hypertension char
